title.en: Population grid data 2015, 1 km x 1 km

description.en:
The number of population on the last day of the reference year (31 December) by age group. Data includes only inhabited grids. 

The statistical variables of the data are: 

* Total population (vaesto), 
* number of men (miehet),
* number of women (naiset), 
* under 15 year-olds (ika_0_14), 
* 15-64 year-olds (ika_15_64), 
* aged over 65 (ika_65_). 
* A grid identifier is expressed using a national identification code derived from the coordinates (idD_nro (num)) and INSPIREs standard identification code (grd_id (char)). 
* The coordinates of the lower left-hand corner of a grid (xkoord, ykoord (num)). 

The data describes the population distribution independent of administrative areas (such as municipal borders). The data is suitable for examination of population distribution and making various spatial analysis.

Additional information: [Statistics Finland, Population grid data 1 km x 1 km](https://www.stat.fi/tup/rajapintapalvelut/vaestoruutuaineisto_1km_en.html)

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)
